how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:legendary-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7785:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ of Rebirth and return it to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7785:details:0: Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn!
rows.quest:7785:progress:0: Will you release him from his eternal prison?
rows.quest:7785:completion:0: May you be protected in your crusade. May the Master bless your efforts.
rows.quest:7786:obj:0: To free ⟦E3⟧ from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the ⟦E4⟧, 10 bars of Elementium, and the ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:7786:details:0: I have told you all that I know, ⟦1⟧. It is you who must find elementium. It is you who must destroy the ⟦E7⟧'s corporeal form.
rows.quest:7786:details:1: Do this and gain the blessing of Thunderaan.
rows.quest:7786:progress:0: Bring the world to its knees if you must!
rows.quest:7786:completion:0: Even in dreams I did not dare foresee this day.
rows.quest:7786:completion:2: BBEHOLD HE WHO IS OLDER THAN EXISTENCE!
rows.quest:7786:completion:3: BBEHOLD HE WHO HAS FACED TITAN AND GOD ALIKE!
rows.quest:7786:completion:4: BRISE MY MASTER! BREAK FROM YOUR BONDS!
rows.quest:7787:details:0: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.
rows.quest:7787:completion:0: Please do not harm me! Take it! Take the blade! Leave Demitrian to reshape his pathetic life!
rows.quest:9250:obj:0: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
rows.quest:9250:details:0: With the frame formed, ⟦E11⟧ is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for ⟦E12⟧'s evil.
rows.quest:9250:details:1: Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
rows.quest:9250:completion:1: Do not mourn their passing, ⟦2⟧. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the ⟦E13⟧ was fated...
rows.quest:9251:obj:0: ⟦E14⟧ at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E15⟧ wants the ⟦E16⟧ and the ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:9251:details:0: You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, ⟦3⟧. I only do as I must.
rows.quest:9251:details:1: Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in ⟦E18⟧, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.
rows.quest:9251:details:2: As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered ⟦E19⟧. He has left ⟦E19⟧ but the base of ⟦E11⟧ remains.
rows.quest:9251:details:3: Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
rows.quest:9251:progress:0: In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.
rows.quest:9251:completion:0: There is a being within... a being not of this world.
rows.quest:9257:obj:0: ⟦E14⟧ at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E15⟧ wants you to take ⟦E20⟧ to ⟦E21⟧ and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
rows.quest:9257:details:0: This final task will be the most difficult of all, ⟦4⟧. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:9257:details:1: Take the staff to ⟦E21⟧. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
